The '''Committee for Renewal''' was a secret organization composed of ten [[Merchant/Legends|merchants]] and companies of a [[City/Legends|city]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The [[Stalton Syndicate]], a group of criminals, moved in the city and extorted [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] from legitimate merchants. The organization wanted to stop the syndicate and hired a group of [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]].<ref name="Dangerous Covenants" />
